name: compliance-badges
purpose: The compliance band: a framed media split whose copy states the certifications and whose media is a frame grid of badges, each a picture over a check-marked pill, closed by a "see more" cell. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'compliance-badges', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `media-split` and `card-grid`.
useWhen: On security, enterprise or pricing pages, to list the certifications and link to the compliance page.
related: media-split` — the copy-beside-media band this section renders through.
bestPractices: Four or five certifications plus the link cell fill two rows of three.
Give every badge an `alt` naming the certification; the pill repeats it for sighted readers.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the media split as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the badge list.

props.name: certifications
props.doc: The badges, in order; each is `{ label, badge, alt }` where `badge` is the picture URL and `label` the pill text.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The closing "see more" cell; `{ label, href }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ComplianceBadges from '@aziontech/webkit/compliance-badges'
  import ccpaSymbolColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/ccpa-symbol-color.svg'
  import gdprSymbolColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/gdpr-symbol-color.svg'
  import lgpdSymbolColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/lgpd-symbol-color.svg'
  import pciDssSymbolColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/pci-dss-symbol-color.svg'
  import socSymbolColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/soc-symbol-color.svg'
</script>

<template>
  <ComplianceBadges
    eyebrow="Compliance"
    title="Meet your compliance requirements"
    description="Azion's certifications help customers and global partners meet a wide range of compliance requirements."
    aria-label="Compliance certifications"
    :certifications="[
      {
        label: 'SOC 2 & 3',
        badge: socSymbolColor,
        alt: 'AICPA SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'PCI DSS',
        badge: pciDssSymbolColor,
        alt: 'PCI DSS badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'LGPD',
        badge: lgpdSymbolColor,
        alt: 'LGPD badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'GDPR',
        badge: gdprSymbolColor,
        alt: 'GDPR badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'CCPA',
        badge: ccpaSymbolColor,
        alt: 'CCPA badge'
      }
    ]"
    :primary-action="{ label: 'See more', href: '/compliance' }"
  />
</template>
